difficultyRationale: Checks how the throws clause may change during method overriding, especially for checked exceptions.
prompt: A superclass method declares a checked exception in its `throws` clause. Which changes are allowed in a valid overriding method? Select all that apply.
explanation: An overriding method may omit the checked exception or declare a narrower checked exception compatible with the overridden declaration. It may not broaden the checked exception contract.

options.explanation: An overriding method may declare fewer checked exceptions.

options.text: Declare a narrower checked exception subtype.
options.explanation: A compatible narrower checked exception is permitted.

options.text: Declare a broader checked exception superclass not permitted by the overridden method.
options.explanation: That would widen the checked exception contract and is not allowed.

options.text: Replace the checked exception with arbitrary unrelated checked exceptions.
options.explanation: Unrelated checked exceptions must still satisfy the overriding throws-clause restrictions.

references.title: JLS 8.4.8.3 Requirements in Overriding and Hiding
